meaning_history/senses.gloss: half; one of two equal parts
meaning_history/senses.text: “Half” is the established current meaning and appears in historical examples, including the cited bronze numeral use 大半升. One proposal treats “half” as an extension of “split/open”; another treats “half” as the original meaning. The evidence does not settle the disagreement.
This use is documented with later examples; its emergence and relation to other meanings are unresolved.

meaning_history/senses.gloss: 磐, in a reported manuscript spelling
meaning_history/senses.text: 半 is reported in a Mawangdui Zhouyi manuscript where the received text has 磐桓. The proposed borrowing mechanism is that 半 stood for 磐 because their spoken forms sounded alike or similarly. Reconstructions suggest similar labial onsets and -an material, but come from different systems and do not establish the manuscript token’s sound or the reason for the spelling. This is graph reuse, not a meaning of 半.
